title: The Shape of the World
description:
Not every great discovery contains a loot chest. A valley, a natural arch or a towering cliff can be worth recording simply because it exists.

Screenshots, waypoints and your own notes count. No fabricated scenic biome registry is required.

Field note: For procedural terrain, use an opt-in journal mark or screenshot—not a fabricated structure detector.

objectives.name: Note an interesting landscape or landmark
